notes.A: The memorial anchors the square, though its stepped base hides part of the pool.
notes.B: The flame and inscription sit below a walled churchyard, but the pedestal is cropped.
notes.C: The pool reads clearly beneath the fiery sky, but the monument recedes to the left.
notes.D: The pool, memorial, and church spire share the view, but a lamppost interrupts the inscription.
notes.E: The elevated view explains the square’s layout, but the nearest lamp crowds the memorial.
notes.F: The flame stands against the fiery skyline, but the pool barely enters the frame.
notes.G: The sky and open paving dominate, with the memorial clipped at the left edge.
notes.H: The flame and inscription read well, but a large foreground lamp competes for attention.

monument.place: Flame memorial in a city square
monument.best: The eternal flame, sunken pool, streetlamps, and corner storefront share the frame beneath the fiery sky.
monument.lacks: The plaza lacks a landmark at the scale of its surroundings. The low stone memorial gets lost against the broad paving and tall façades.
monument.fix: Replace the squat pedestal with a tall, tapered stone monument that raises the flame and gives the square a recognizable silhouette.

blind_name.name: Flame Monument Plaza
blind_name.why: A flame crowns a stepped stone pedestal in a cobblestone square with streetlamps and a brick building.
blind_name.odd: The fiery sky dwarfs the buildings, and deep shadows obscure the far side of the square.

notes.A: The tower and branching streets give the city depth, but the near façade hides one corner.
notes.B: The entrance and side street are clear, but the head-on façade flattens the junction.
notes.C: It shows the entrance and paving, but the foreground lamp crowds out the street.
notes.D: The junction and square read together, but the broad paving feels empty.
notes.E: The lamps trace the square’s edge, but the near wall cuts off the street.
notes.F: The corner block anchors the avenue, but its repetitive windows dominate the view.
notes.G: Street level gives the buildings height, but the narrow view hides most of the square.
notes.H: The lamp and burning sky set the mood, but the foreground pole interrupts the junction.

avenue.best: D shows how the cobbled streets meet the lamplit square, with tall brick blocks and a fiery skyline.
avenue.lacks: The square lacks a destination. The lamps mark its edges, but the empty center gives the surrounding streets little reason to meet there.
avenue.fix: Build a lit stone fountain in the square so the approaching streets lead to a shared landmark.

blind_name.name: Cobblestone city intersection
blind_name.why: Cobblestone streets meet beside a tall brick building, with glowing streetlamps lining the sidewalks.
blind_name.odd: The fiery sky looks heavily pixelated.

notes.A: Stained glass and tower masonry frame the pavement, but the entrance disappears behind the tower.
notes.B: The raised angle reveals the roof and enclosed yard, but the foreground wall hides the approach.
notes.C: The full window row and recessed door read clearly, but the flat angle compresses the church.
notes.D: The long street gives the church an urban setting, but foreshortening squeezes its windows together.
notes.E: The roof, windows, and doorway read together, though the foreground wall crowds the church.
notes.F: The windows and door are clear, but blank pavement dominates and the roof is cropped.
notes.G: The church and street read together, though the doorway sinks into shadow.
notes.H: The red sky frames the roof and tower, but the tower hides the entrance.

church_out.place: Church on a dark city street
church_out.best: G shows how the stained-glass nave, tower, and doorway sit along the cobbled street beneath the red sky.
church_out.lacks: The church lacks a focal point at street level. Its repeated windows draw the eye past a small doorway that barely registers as the entrance.
church_out.fix: Give the tower a tall, recessed pointed-arch stone portal that marks the entrance from down the street.

blind_name.name: Church exterior
blind_name.why: Tall stained-glass windows line the stone wall beside a square tower and recessed wooden door.
blind_name.odd: The tower is cropped at the top, and the doorway is very dark.

notes.A: Two pew rows lead toward a distant altar, while the low overhang crowds the view.
notes.B: Altar, pews, and skeletons share the frame, though the nearest pew is cut off.
notes.C: The crest and pew rows give the reverse view character, but a foreground skeleton intrudes.
notes.D: Colored windows and a skeleton frame the pews, but the stone pier hides the sanctuary.
notes.E: The altar reads immediately, but a pew blocks the central approach.
notes.F: The portrait and side windows add detail, while the altar is clipped at left.
notes.G: Candles mark the sanctuary edge, but close pew backs dominate the frame.
notes.H: High windows and pew rows show the nave’s scale, but the altar hugs the edge.

nave.best: B ties together the candlelit altar, pews, colored windows, wall hanging, and skeletons in one readable view.
nave.lacks: The nave lacks a clear processional aisle. The pews interrupt the route to the altar, weakening the room’s focal point.
nave.fix: Arrange the pews in two banks with an uninterrupted central aisle leading straight to the altar steps.

blind_name.name: Chapel interior
blind_name.why: Wooden pews face a raised altar flanked by candles, with stained glass behind it.
blind_name.odd: The figure in the stained glass is hard to make out.

notes.A: Sarcophagus, reliefs, and skeleton read clearly. A blank pillar takes up the right edge.
notes.B: A bloody aisle leads toward the skeleton. The near pillar blocks the room.
notes.C: The hooded cultist fills the frame, hiding nearly everything that identifies the crypt.
notes.D: Paired reliefs and barrels frame the tomb. The coffin and cultist are both clipped.
notes.E: Both figures stand among the reliefs. The coffin’s near side dominates the foreground.
notes.F: Cobwebs, barrels, and coffin carvings show clearly. The skeleton is clipped at the edge.
notes.G: A hooded cultist stands beneath a relief. The coffin runs out of frame.
notes.H: The coffin and barrels give the room depth. A looming skeleton steals the focus.

crypt.best: The angled view gives the sarcophagus depth and shows it among carved reliefs, cobwebs, torchlight, and a skeleton.
crypt.lacks: The crypt lacks a distinct burial area. Repeated reliefs and flat, dim walls give the sarcophagus little architectural emphasis.
crypt.fix: Give the sarcophagus an arched burial alcove raised one step above the crypt floor.

blind_name.name: Stone crypt with a sarcophagus
blind_name.why: A stone sarcophagus, skeletal wall reliefs, cobwebs, and a torch fill the chamber.
blind_name.odd: The sarcophagus lid’s carving is hard to make out.

notes.A: A bare tree marks the bend, but the near wall hides most of the yard.
notes.B: The roof crowds out the path and trees beneath the fiery sky.
notes.C: Trees frame the path and battered walls, but the path leads to a blank wall.
notes.D: The elevated view explains the layout, but the church wall fills the right side.
notes.E: The path, street opening, and red sky establish the setting, but masonry hides the church.
notes.F: The alley opening connects the yard to the city, but foreground masonry blocks the view.
notes.G: The full path and surrounding walls read clearly, but the repetitive skyline pulls attention upward.
notes.H: The church profile is clearest here, but a foreground tree hides the path.

churchyard.best: C follows the dirt path between autumn trees, with crumbling walls, the church flank, and the city skyline in view.
churchyard.lacks: The path has no recognizable destination. Bare trees and battered masonry give the yard atmosphere, but little identifies it as a churchyard.
churchyard.fix: Place a low, weathered stone tomb with a carved cross where the path meets the back wall.

blind_name.name: Walled churchyard
blind_name.why: A dirt path runs between sparse trees and stone walls beneath a building with rows of arched windows.
blind_name.odd: Deep shadows obscure parts of the ground.

notes.A: The high angle shows both façades. The entrance sinks into the bottom edge.
notes.B: The sign is legible. The foreground brick wall hides much of the passage.
notes.C: The clock marks the passage. A low brick wall dominates the view.
notes.D: The clock and entrance read clearly. The angle crops the station sign.
notes.E: Repeated windows lead toward the red sky. The entrance is out of frame.
notes.F: The clock and passage sit beside the station frontage. The sign runs offscreen.
notes.G: The sign, passage, and street read together. The doorway itself is hard to distinguish.
notes.H: The lettering and opposite façade frame a long alley. The entrance gets lost.

station_front.place: Station entrance on a narrow street
station_front.best: G shows the full station sign, the recessed entrance, and the narrow street under a red sky.
station_front.lacks: The station lacks a recognizable front door. Its sign identifies the building, and the recessed passage looks like another gap in the wall.
station_front.fix: Give the existing passage a tall, illuminated entrance arch that breaks the repetitive window line and marks where to go.

blind_name.name: Brick building entrance
blind_name.why: A recessed passage opens beside a long brick façade with rows of windows and a paved walkway.
blind_name.odd: The small illuminated signs are unreadable, and the far end of the walkway fades into black.

notes.A: Tracks and carriage lead toward the station clock, but the roof hides most windows.
notes.B: Posters, benches and a waiting figure give the platform life, but the roof dominates.
notes.C: Curtained carriage windows stand out, but the tight crop loses the tracks.
notes.D: The carriage roof leads to the track gate, but hides nearly everything at platform level.
notes.E: Clock, benches and iron gates define the waiting room, but the foreground hides the rails.
notes.F: Rails, carriage and clock share the frame, but the station entrance is clipped.
notes.G: Locomotive and carriage make the railway unmistakable, though the waiting room recedes into shadow.
notes.H: The high angle shows the track layout, but a blank wall dominates.

platform.best: G shows the locomotive, green carriage, parallel tracks and brick station facade together.
platform.lacks: A clear focal point at the boarding area. The dim lighting lets the carriage and station entrance blend into the dark masonry.
platform.fix: Install warm platform lamps above the waiting-room entrance to light the boarding area and catch the side of the carriage.

blind_name.name: Railway loading platform
blind_name.why: Parallel tracks run beside a raised platform with wooden crates, and a small locomotive sits on one track.
blind_name.odd: The lighting makes details in the rear doorway hard to read.

notes.A: The passage and arrivals board read clearly, but the head-on view flattens the hall.
notes.B: Posters, clock and telephone give the corner character, but the waiting figure is cropped.
notes.C: The waiting figure and columns show the hall’s scale, but the nearest column dominates.
notes.D: The passage and benches establish the layout, but blank brick and paving dominate.
notes.E: The platform edge, waiting figure and far wall fit together, but the station name clips.
notes.F: Benches and columns show the hall’s length and platform connection, but the station name clips.
notes.G: The clock, telephone and wrestling poster read clearly, but the foreground bench crowds everything.
notes.H: The sign, waiting figure and benches anchor the view, though the platform barely registers.

booking_hall.best: The Gravesend sign, clock, posters, telephone, benches and waiting figure give the hall an identity, with the platform visible beyond.
booking_hall.lacks: The hall lacks a clear focal point. The low ceiling and continuous dark brick give the booking area the same visual weight as the passage.
booking_hall.fix: Rebuild the ticket counter as a broad, warmly lit service window at the end of the hall.

blind_name.name: Reception hall
blind_name.why: A low wooden divider runs across the tiled hall, with a wall clock beside an interior doorway.
blind_name.odd: The room is dim, and the clock face is hard to read.

notes.A: Shows flag, cargo, and open water, but the mast splits the view and hides town.
notes.B: Shows where the boardwalk meets town, but an oversized foreground crate hides the harbor.
notes.C: Shows the dock, cargo, and waterfront shops, but the near platform blocks the water.
notes.D: Shows the inlet and raised cargo deck clearly, but leaves most of the town out.
notes.E: Shows cargo, pilings, flag, and town together, but thick foreground posts crowd the waterline.
notes.F: Shows the channel and flagged cargo deck, but the city disappears into shadow.
notes.G: Shows the lamplit square and monument, but only a strip of boardwalk suggests the harbor.
notes.H: Shows the flagged deck alongside the quay, but the far end disappears into darkness.

harbour.best: E puts the skull flag, cargo, timber piers, and lamplit city in one view, with water between the docks.
harbour.lacks: The harbor lacks a landmark on the water. Crates and flags suggest a pirate port, but low wooden decks give it little identity beyond the waterfront textures.
harbour.fix: Berth one tall-masted cargo ship beside the quay, with a gangplank linking its deck to the crates.

blind_name.name: Harbour docks
blind_name.why: Wooden piers, mooring posts, and crates sit beside dark water with brick buildings behind them.
blind_name.odd: Deep shadows obscure much of the background.

notes.A: Jugs and a loaf line the open frontage, but a wooden partition dominates.
notes.B: The frontage and wooden partitions share the frame, but a counter blocks the aisle.
notes.C: Parallel counters define the main aisle, though their bare tops dominate the view.
notes.D: The clock anchors a side aisle, but a close wooden partition hides most stalls.
notes.E: The aisle leads to a clock and a few wares, but counters crowd both edges.
notes.F: The island, shelves, and frontage read together, though the island looks bare.
notes.G: The entrance connects the market to the courtyard, but the low lintel hides the interior.
notes.H: The clock and jugs give the frontage character, but a counter end cuts off the aisle.

market_hall.best: F shows how the central island, wall shelving, wooden partitions, and open frontage fit around the checkerboard aisles.
market_hall.lacks: The hall lacks a distinctive display of goods. Scattered props leave the central island looking like a barrier in an empty room.
market_hall.fix: Turn the central island into a produce stall with open crates of colorful fruit and vegetables visible from both aisles.

blind_name.name: Tiled room with central counter
blind_name.why: A large brick-faced counter stands on a checkerboard floor, with wooden panels along the back wall.
blind_name.odd: The passage on the right is too dark to make out clearly.

notes.A: A silver vessel and bottles give the shop character, but the foreground wall hides it.
notes.B: The poster and checkerboard threshold frame the bookstall, but the corner cuts it in half.
notes.C: Candles, bookshelves, and a long counter define the bookshop, but crowd out the arcade.
notes.D: The clock faces and display window identify the clock shop, but the bookstall barely registers.
notes.E: The raised view reveals the clock shop’s display, but crops its sign and storefront.
notes.F: The bookstall anchors the concourse, though the neighboring shopfronts blend into the brickwork.
notes.G: The bookstall and figures give the arcade scale, but the blank bay dominates.
notes.H: The tiled passage frames a glimpse of the arcade, but hides most shopfronts.

arcade.best: F shows the bookstall, neighboring shopfronts, and figures in a single view of the patterned concourse.
arcade.lacks: The arcade lacks a landmark. Its shop signs and display objects are too small to compete with the continuous dark brickwork.
arcade.fix: Build a tall, illuminated pendulum clock into the far bay so the clock shop announces itself across the concourse.

blind_name.name: Ornate hallway beside a library
blind_name.why: Bookshelves and candles sit in a checkered alcove off the patterned hallway.
blind_name.odd: Deep shadows obscure some wall and shelf details.

notes.A: The corner reveals the raised platform, but a post interrupts the view across the lobby.
notes.B: The ticket sign and Jo-Jo poster establish the theater, but the foreground post crowds them.
notes.C: The floor tracks lead past potted plants, but a close cultist blocks the left side.
notes.D: Two enemies flank the manager’s entrance, but the broad overhang hides the ticket area.
notes.E: The stage door and both enemies anchor the view, though the signage is dim.
notes.F: The raised platform and molding fill the frame, leaving few clues to the room’s purpose.
notes.G: The manager and stage door signs read clearly, but a cultist obscures the approach.
notes.H: The ticket sign and poster identify the lobby, but the low ceiling dominates.

auditorium.best: E shows how the manager’s entrance, stage door, and raised platform fit together, with both enemies visible.
auditorium.lacks: The lobby lacks a focal point. The ticket area blends into the patterned walls, leaving the signs to explain what the room is for.
auditorium.fix: Turn the ticket area into a recessed, warmly lit box office that stands out across the lobby.

blind_name.name: Ornate auditorium
blind_name.why: Patterned walls, decorative molding, and a low raised platform suggest a theater interior.
blind_name.odd: The room is dim, and the small wall sign is hard to read.

notes.A: Patrons and stools peek past a close wall that takes up half the frame.
notes.B: The aisle reveals both counters and the wall art, but a tall chair interrupts it.
notes.C: The full whiskey sign identifies the room, but a blank partition dominates the right.
notes.D: The whiskey sign and bottles set the scene, but oversized foreground bottles crowd out seating.
notes.E: The high angle shows the bar and stools, but crops the sign and diminishes patrons.
notes.F: Paintings and drinks line the counter, but the near partition cuts off the room.
notes.G: The long bar and its patrons read clearly, but an empty tabletop dominates the foreground.
notes.H: Patrons, stools, drinks, and signage come together, though the central chair partly blocks the bar.

saloon.best: H shows the saloon’s character in one frame, with patrons, drinks, red stools, wall art, and the whiskey sign.
saloon.lacks: A distinctive focal point behind the bar. The counter blends into the dark paneling, so scattered props have to carry the saloon’s identity.
saloon.fix: Install a warmly lit, mirrored bottle display behind the main counter to give the saloon a recognizable centerpiece.

blind_name.name: Saloon interior
blind_name.why: A long wooden bar, liquor bottles, stemmed glasses, and red bar stools fill the room.
blind_name.odd: The tall chair backs look like tangled metal, and the painting is hard to make out.

notes.A: The window ledge and skeletal clerk frame a view dominated by the opposite building.
notes.B: The signs, coats, and counter sell the shop immediately, but the storefront display is out of frame.
notes.C: The display ledge and barred window establish the layout, but the closed door dominates.
notes.D: The goblets, candle, and jug read clearly against a street façade that overwhelms the shop.
notes.E: The skeletal clerk gives the counter character, but a thick mullion splits the view.
notes.F: The coats and checkerboard aisle lead toward a plain door, with the nearest coat cropped.
notes.G: The corner window shows pottery, the barred window, and LOANS, but cuts off the pawn counter.
notes.H: The storefront pulls the goods and signage together, though the dark ceiling takes up considerable space.

pawn.best: H shows the streetfront, window display, hanging coats, and pawn counter together, with both signs readable.
pawn.lacks: The shop feels understocked. A few widely spaced props leave the open floor bare and give the storefront no focal point.
pawn.fix: Add a low, brightly lit display case of mismatched watches, tools, and jewelry on the open floor where passersby can see it.

blind_name.name: Pawn shop window
blind_name.why: Coats hang behind a counter, with pottery, goblets, and candles displayed in a street-facing window.
blind_name.odd: The tiny display labels are unreadable.

notes.A: Broad grating and low machinery establish the hall, but the sludge basin stays hidden.
notes.B: Parallel grates lead beneath a low overhang that hides most of the room.
notes.C: Sludge lettering and an orange control panel frame the walkway, but the basin is hidden.
notes.D: A striped upright marks the narrow catwalk, while foreground columns obscure its destination.
notes.E: The basin and curving catwalk show the layout, but the near pillar blocks the center.
notes.F: The basin and controls share a sightline, but close walls squeeze them into a slot.
notes.G: Hazard stripes and partial sludge lettering mark a grated platform that leads into shadow.
notes.H: Sludge, catwalk, and controls surround a column that blocks the view across the basin.

machine_hall.best: H ties the sludge basin, central column, grated walkway, hazard stripes, and control bank together in one view.
machine_hall.lacks: A focal machine that makes the hall’s purpose visible. The controls, grates, and sludge suggest a process the room never shows.
machine_hall.fix: Replace the central column with a lit sludge processor whose outlet visibly pours into the basin.

blind_name.name: Industrial machine hall
blind_name.why: Rusted metal walls, hazard stripes, grated walkways, and control panels surround a pit of green liquid.
blind_name.odd: The central pillar blocks much of the view, and the control panel markings are unreadable.

notes.A: The channel skirts an open junction, but the broad dark floor dominates.
notes.B: A sludge basin, small creature, and stone block compete for attention in the gloom.
notes.C: Moss and a distant torch mark the passage, but repeating panels swallow the view.
notes.D: A torch lights the junction, but the sludge channel barely makes the frame.
notes.E: Moss, debris, and a grate define the walkway, though the far end fades into darkness.
notes.F: A gray stone block fills the alcove and hides almost everything distinctive about the sewer.
notes.G: The channel bends around a corner, but a blank wall takes up half the frame.
notes.H: An overhead grate and a small creature frame the channel, though the passage beyond disappears.

sewer.best: E shows the sludge channel, narrow walkway, moss, scattered debris, and overhead grate together in one readable view.
sewer.lacks: The sewer lacks a landmark that gives its channels a purpose. The same low ceiling and wall panels make every turn feel alike.
sewer.fix: Turn the open junction into a taller sluice chamber where a lit floodgate visibly feeds the existing channel.

blind_name.name: Sewer corridor
blind_name.why: A green sludge channel runs along rust-streaked walls under round ceiling lights.
blind_name.odd: The orange tangle on the floor is hard to identify.

notes.A: The approach corridor ends at a dark opening that conceals the stairs and ticket grille.
notes.B: The EXIT sign and ticket grille establish the setting, but the stairs are mostly cropped.
notes.C: The TICKETS sign and grille read clearly, but a foreground pillar cuts off the landing.
notes.D: The stairs lead toward a brighter opening, but the thick divider hides the ticket booth.
notes.E: The stairs climb toward a sliver of light, but the low, dark ceiling dominates.
notes.F: The stairs and ticket wall peek around a corner that takes up half the view.
notes.G: The stairs and ticket grille explain the layout, though the booth sinks into shadow.
notes.H: The EXIT sign marks the entrance, but the dark recess hides where the stairs lead.

underpass.best: The stairs, EXIT sign, and barred ticket booth share one view, with the landing showing how they connect.
underpass.lacks: The landing lacks a focal point. The ticket booth gives the place its identity, yet its grille recedes into the same murk as the surrounding walls.
underpass.fix: Add a warm light inside the ticket booth so the grille stands out and light spills onto the landing.

blind_name.name: Gated stone underpass
blind_name.why: Stone steps rise on the left, and a metal gate blocks the passage on the right.
blind_name.odd: Deep shadows obscure details behind the gate.

notes.A: The sign, food counter and door read clearly, but the tight crop hides the yard.
notes.B: The approach leads toward the shop, but the near stone wall crowds the view.
notes.C: The corner reveals the yard’s bend and both figures, but the stone pier dominates.
notes.D: The reverse angle shows the recessed passage, but the foreground lamp blocks much of it.
notes.E: Checkerboard tiles and stools identify the eatery, but the close angle barely shows the courtyard.
notes.F: The high angle shows the yard’s footprint, but the cropped storefront weakens its identity.
notes.G: The shop and side passage share the frame, but the dark recess dominates the left.
notes.H: The shop, lamp and figures establish the courtyard, though the empty brick frontage feels monotonous.

works_yard.best: H shows the Rat Dogs storefront, checkerboard interior, lamppost and robed figures together, with room to read the yard.
works_yard.lacks: The courtyard has little purpose beyond passage. The eatery gives one corner character, while the long brick wall borders an expanse of paving with no distinct use.
works_yard.fix: Add a small Rat Dogs outdoor seating area along the brick wall, extending the eatery into the courtyard.

blind_name.name: Cobblestone courtyard with streetlamp
blind_name.why: A glowing streetlamp stands on dark paving between a windowed building and a tall brick wall.
blind_name.odd: The tall brick wall has rows of identical tiny windows.

notes.A: Pans, safety signs and one stool frame a grill cut off by the bottom edge.
notes.B: The grill and stools suggest a diner, but the steel door dominates the back wall.
notes.C: The grill, pans and street opening establish the diner, though the seating barely registers.
notes.D: Rats line the sill beside the grill, but the corner hides most of the room.
notes.E: Stools, grill and street opening show the layout, though blank walls flatten the diner’s character.
notes.F: Stools and the street opening show where customers sit, but the grill is mostly cropped.
notes.G: The door, stools and grill peek past a wall that fills the foreground.
notes.H: The stools and street opening give the room depth, but the grill is cropped.

ratdogs.best: C puts the rat-covered grill, hanging pans, handwashing sign and street opening in one readable view.
ratdogs.lacks: The stools have nowhere to pull up, and the low grill looks like a crate. There’s no clear place to order or eat.
ratdogs.fix: Rebuild the rat-covered grill as a waist-high lunch counter with a serving ledge facing the stools.

blind_name.name: Kitchen with a central grill
blind_name.why: Two frying pans hang above a checkerboard floor, and a raised grate sits in the center.
blind_name.odd: Small brown shapes on the grate look like rats, but the pixelation makes them hard to identify.
